items.title: Aon CEO says insurance broker seeks to build 'premiere middle market platform' with purchase of rival USI
items.summary: Insurance broker Aon announced on Monday it will purchase rival USI Insurance Services from private equity firm KKR .

items.title: Kalshi partners with brokerage Alpaca as it tries to build its international audience
items.summary: Prediction market platform Kalshi is working with brokerage and financial infrastructure startup Alpaca to bring its event contracts to an international audience, subject to local regulatory approval.

items.title: Crypto exchange Gemini not at fault for collapse of Earn lending program, arbitrator says
items.summary: Gemini Space Station scored a legal victory earlier in August after an arbitrator found the crypto exchange did not mislead users and was not at fault for the collapse of its Earn lending program.

items.title: China's Xi builds diplomatic clout with multiple state visits ahead of Trump summit
items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to make rare state visits to Egypt and, likely India, before his expected trip to the U.S. in late September.

items.title: Jackson Hole analyst roundup: Warsh's speech sends hike chances higher, may put Fed 'at odds' with Treasury
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's stance in his speech at the Jackson Hole meeting was unexpectedly hawkish , boosting market expectations for a rate hike next month.

items.title: India’s economy expands 7.8% in fiscal first quarter, beating estimates
items.summary: India's economy grew by 7.8% in the quarter to the end of June, mainly driven by strong performance of the financial, real estate, information technology and professional services sectors.

items.title: Bank of England chief warns new AI models threaten global financial stability
items.summary: The growing threat posed by advanced artificial intelligence models could trigger a disorderly correction in global financial markets, according to Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey.

items.title: China's factory activity shrinks for second straight month, contracting less than expected
items.summary: China's manufacturing activity in August shrank for a second straight month, though by less than market estimates, keeping the pressure on Beijing to support the economy as growth loses momentum.

items.title: Singapore tackles finances and culture to avert a demographic crisis
items.summary: Tiny Singapore is throwing cash and incentives at its citizens to avoid a long-term demographic crisis, but it may take many years before the level of success becomes clear.
